## Aphrody practice (measured)

1. Configure the surface once: one `GPUCanvasContext.configure()` with the device and `navigator.gpu.getPreferredCanvasFormat()`; a resize only changes `canvas.width`/`height`, which replaces the drawing buffer without reconfiguring. [WebGPU: GPUCanvasContext.configure(configuration) (method)](https://gpuweb.github.io/gpuweb/#dom-gpucanvascontext-configure) [WebGPU § 21.4.1 Canvas Context sizing](https://gpuweb.github.io/gpuweb/#context-sizing)
2. Size from `ResizeObserver` `devicePixelContentBoxSize`, clamped to `device.limits.maxTextureDimension2D` (a larger canvas fails validation in `getCurrentTexture()`). [Resize Observer: ResizeObserverBoxOptions."device-pixel-content-box" (enum-value)](https://drafts.csswg.org/resize-observer-1/#dom-resizeobserverboxoptions-device-pixel-content-box) [WebGPU: supported limits.maxTextureDimension2D (attribute)](https://gpuweb.github.io/gpuweb/#dom-supported-limits-maxtexturedimension2d)
3. Render on demand: one `requestAnimationFrame` when state or size changes, then `getCurrentTexture()` for that frame; no free-running loop. [HTML: AnimationFrameProvider.requestAnimationFrame(callback) (method)](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/imagebitmap-and-animations.html#dom-animationframeprovider-requestanimationframe) [WebGPU: GPUCanvasContext.getCurrentTexture() (method)](https://gpuweb.github.io/gpuweb/#dom-gpucanvascontext-getcurrenttexture)
4. No WebGL fallback: when `navigator.gpu` is missing or `requestAdapter()` resolves `null`, say WebGPU is unavailable. [WebGPU: GPU.requestAdapter(options) (method)](https://gpuweb.github.io/gpuweb/#dom-gpu-requestadapter)
